definitions: Each of a set of standardised parts or independent units that can be used to construct a more complex structure, such as an item of furniture or a building.
A self-contained unit of a course of study.
A distinct, self-contained unit of a computer program.
A unit of measurement, especially one used in assessing the proportions of a building.
examples: The computer consists of several modules.
The course is divided into three modules.
The software is built from reusable modules.
